newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to develop Singapore applications.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to develop Singapore applications.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Multimedia Group said Tuesday it agreed to participate in a program to facilitate development of interactive content and applications for Singapore's interactive broadband network.
Motorola Multimedia signed a memorandum of understanding with the National Computer Board in Singapore to help develop broadband network content through the CyberSeed Venture Program.
It will participate in Singapore ONE, a national high-capacity network launched in June 1996.

Through the relationship, Motorola expects multimedia applications to become available for all Singaporeans. "Karaoke-on-demand, video telephony, home shopping -- we are confident these services and more will emerge from this exciting partnership," said Jim Phillips, corporate vice president for Motorola.
Phillips said more than 300,000 homes are passed by Singapore Cable Vision's two-way hybrid fiber-coaxial cable network. By April, the Singapore ONE technical trial will begin with 300 households.
The pilot program could be scaled up to more than 5,000 households with some 100 services by year-end.
